other_conditions: Holder of a Ph.D. in Science/Engineering or an MS/MD in Medicine
Must hold a regular academic/research position in State Universities/Colleges or private Academic Institutions
Should not have any ongoing research projects or fellowships at the time of application
Age relaxation of 5 years for SC, ST, OBC, physically challenged and women candidates
Mentor must be at the level of Associate Professor/Scientist E or higher
Only one candidate is allowed to work with a mentor at any given time
benefits_summary: Provides a research fellowship of ₹60,000 per year and a research grant of ₹5 lakh per annum.
